templates.name: home
templates.description: WKND site homepage. Hero carousel with rotating adventure slides, a featured magazine article teaser, a 'Recent Articles' image-list grid linking to magazine stories, a promotional adventure teaser (Climbing New Zealand), and a 'Where do you want to go?' image-list grid of adventure trips. Header and footer are shared experience fragments.

templates.name: magazine-landing
templates.description: Magazine landing/index page. Page title heading, a featured article teaser (Camping in Western Australia), an 'All Articles' image-list grid of article cards (image, title, description), and a 'Members Only' section with gated teaser cards. Header and footer are shared experience fragments.

templates.name: magazine-article
templates.description: Magazine article detail page. Full-bleed lead image, breadcrumb navigation, article title and byline, long-form body content with headings, paragraphs and pull-quotes, an author bio block with social links, and a 'Share This Story' sidebar listing related articles. All five article URLs share a near-identical structure. Header and footer are shared experience fragments.

templates.name: about
templates.description: About Us page. Page title heading, an 'Our Contributors' section with intro text and a grid of contributor profile cards (name, role, social links), and a 'WKND Guides' section with intro text and a grid of guide profile cards. Header and footer are shared experience fragments.

templates.name: adventures-landing
templates.description: Adventures listing page. Serif page title ('Adventures'), an intro hero teaser (full-bleed background photo with an overlaid heading 'Experience the world with us' and a short description), and a 'Current Adventures' section rendering a dynamic responsive grid of adventure cards (image, uppercase title link, short description) linking to each adventure detail page. The source filter tabs (All/Climbing/Cycling/Skiing/Surfing/Travel) are out of scope; the listing is modeled as a single flat grid of all 16 adventures. Header and footer are shared experience fragments.

templates.name: adventure-detail
templates.description: Adventure detail page (16 adventures share this structure). Full-bleed lead image, H1 title with underline accent, a structured TRIP DETAILS key/value panel (Activity, Adventure Type, Trip Length, Group Size, Difficulty, Price), long-form Overview/Itinerary/What to Bring body content (source tabs flattened to headings, paragraphs, inline image and a bulleted list), a 'Share this Adventure' heading, and a row of social share/follow icon links. Header and footer are shared experience fragments.
